_about: Rules, regulations and notifications made under the Companies Act, 2017, with the sections they carry out. `library` names the instrument's id when its text is in the library; `sections` lists the Act's sections; `basis` says where the link comes from; `confirm` lists what still has to be checked against the instrument itself. Sections cited by instruments in the library are found automatically and need not be listed here. `url` links to the instrument's page on the regulator's website; `found` records how the details were found (`search-index`: from a web search engine's index of the regulator's site, to be confirmed against the instrument).

instruments.title: Companies Regulations, 2024
instruments.latest: Amended by S.R.O. 1355(I)/2025 of 25 July 2025 (SECP lists it as “SRO 1356”)
instruments.basis: Made under section 512(1) (recital to the regulations). The sections each regulation cites are linked automatically. Also carries out sections it cites in table or sub-section form, which are not linked automatically: 26–28 (reg. 30, Form-4; reg. 36), 103 and 112 (reg. 30, Registers R-4 and R-5), 227(2)(f) (reg. 30, Form-20), 271 (reg. 58), 285 (reg. 30, Form-22; reg. 59), 479 (reg. 67), 53 and 54 (reg. 34, service of documents on the Commission, registrar or company), 132(2) (reg. 56, video link on demand of members holding ten percent of paid-up capital).
